status: draft: proposed labels and thresholds, pending owner review
description: A support-agent memory: preferences, incidents, policies, product facts, customers, how-tos and office notes. Queries cover exact keywords, paraphrases with little word overlap, questions with several relevant entries, and near-miss distractors. Keyword cases also carry a lexicalQuery of exact terms, because lexical search requires every query token to match.

entries.pref-email-digest: Dana prefers a weekly email digest instead of daily notifications.
entries.pref-timezone-dana: Dana works from Lisbon and schedules meetings in the Western European time zone.
entries.pref-language-kenji: Kenji asked for all summaries to be written in Japanese.
entries.pref-format-tables: Priya wants financial reports formatted as tables, not charts.
entries.incident-db-failover: On March 3 the primary database failed over to the replica after disk exhaustion.
entries.incident-db-postmortem: The postmortem for the March database failover recommended disk usage alerts at 80 percent.
entries.incident-cdn-outage: A CDN outage on April 12 caused image loading failures in Europe for forty minutes.
entries.incident-payment-retry: Duplicate card charges happened when the payment provider timed out and the client retried.
entries.policy-refund-30: Refunds are allowed within 30 days of purchase with a receipt.
entries.policy-refund-digital: Digital downloads cannot be refunded once the license key has been revealed.
entries.policy-escalation-sev1: Severity one incidents must page the on-call engineer and the incident commander immediately.
entries.policy-data-retention: Customer support transcripts are deleted after 18 months.
entries.policy-password-reset: Password resets require verification through the registered email address.
entries.product-plan-pro: The Pro plan includes 10 seats, priority support and single sign-on.
entries.product-plan-free: The Free plan is limited to one project and community support.
entries.product-api-rate: The public API allows 600 requests per minute per access token.
entries.product-sso-okta: Single sign-on supports Okta and Azure AD through SAML.
entries.customer-acme-renewal: Acme Corp renews its contract every January and negotiates volume discounts.
entries.customer-acme-contact: The main contact at Acme Corp is Lena Fischer, head of procurement.
entries.customer-globex-churn: Globex considered cancelling after repeated sync failures in the mobile app.
entries.customer-globex-fix: The mobile sync bug affecting Globex was fixed in version 4.2.
entries.howto-export-csv: To export data as CSV, open the report, choose Export, then select comma separated values.
entries.howto-invite-user: Admins invite teammates from Settings, Members, Invite by email.
entries.howto-rotate-token: API tokens can be rotated from the developer settings page without downtime.
entries.meeting-roadmap-q3: The Q3 roadmap meeting prioritised offline mode and audit logs.
entries.meeting-hiring: The team agreed to hire two backend engineers before the end of the quarter.
entries.office-wifi: The office guest wifi password is changed on the first Monday of each month.
entries.office-parking: Visitors can park in the north garage with a validation ticket from reception.
entries.vendor-cloud-credits: The startup credits from the cloud provider expire in November.
entries.vendor-support-sla: Enterprise customers receive a four hour response time for urgent tickets.
entries.bug-dark-mode: In dark mode the export button is nearly invisible on the reports page.
entries.bug-timezone-reports: Scheduled reports are sent an hour late after daylight saving time changes.
entries.feature-request-slack: Several customers asked for Slack notifications when a report finishes.
entries.feature-request-webhooks: Integrators want outgoing webhooks for invoice events.
entries.security-mfa: All employees must use multi-factor authentication with a hardware key.
entries.security-phishing: Report suspected phishing emails to the security team using the report button.
entries.finance-invoice-terms: Invoices are payable within 45 days for annual contracts.
entries.finance-currency: Prices for European customers are billed in euros.
entries.travel-policy: Economy class is required for flights shorter than six hours.
entries.onboarding-laptop: New hires receive a laptop on their first day and must enrol it in device management.
